Method of Attack: Malicious apps masquerading as cryptocurrency investment apps promoted as beta versions on mobile app stores to steal crypto and personally identifiable information (PII).
Apps initially appear legitimate and are approved on app stores, then URLs are changed post-approval to point to malicious servers introducing malicious behavior.
Use of social engineering via phishing or romance scams to direct victims to these apps.
Malicious code activates post-installation to perform theft of PII, financial account access, or device takeover.
Attack Vector: Submission of malicious beta apps to mobile app stores (Apple TestFlight and Google Play beta testing).
Social engineering via phishing and romance scams.
Post-approval URL switching in apps to malicious servers.
